title: 第一卷 第5章 太古炼神决第一卷 第6章 柳家的计划
lines: 秦家的众多长老纷纷开口。
很显然，大家对以前柳家各种吸血秦家早就不满。
要不是看在少族长的份上，他们早就和柳家撕破脸了。
现在既然柳家自己不知死活，他们当然乐见其成。
对于这个结果，秦渊当然没有意见。
秦玄这一身的修为确实彻底没有了。
想到这里，秦渊心中也是一阵唏嘘。
秦玄可是火风城秦家年轻一辈最有潜力的存在，现在竟然成了一个废人，这让一直都心高气傲的他如何能接受这个事实。
“玄儿，你放心，无论将来发生什么，只要有爷爷在，我就一定会保护好你，不让你受任何委屈。”
“至于修为的事，你先不用担心，我还有一些人脉，到时候一定可以想办法让你恢复修为！”
对于秦玄的遭遇，秦渊虽然心中剧痛，可他还是勉力安慰孙儿。
“嗯，爷爷你放心，我没事。”
秦玄笑了笑。
在天墓的三年将他的心性可是磨练了不少。
现在的他已经可以做到宠辱不惊。
“好，你能这么想，我也放心了不少。”
秦渊点头说着。
“放心，少族长天赋异禀，一定可以恢复修为！”
其他长老也是纷纷开口。
半晌之后，众人将视线投向秦玄。
看着这么多长老齐齐朝他开口，秦玄心中一阵温暖。
即使自己成了废人，这些长老还是支持自己。
“对了，玄儿，那天墓里面究竟是什么样的？传说天墓深不可见底，不知道是是不是真的？”
听着这话，秦玄苦笑一声。
“进入天墓之后我就昏了过去，醒来时就在天墓底部了，不过奇怪的是，在天墓之中，修士的修为会彻底被压制，任何灵气都无法调动。”
“只能靠着肉身行动。”
说到这里，秦玄不由得一阵唏嘘。
当年自己在天墓中苏醒，遇到了不少麻烦，要不是那个白衣女人，自己或许真的会直接死在里面。
不过一想到那三年在太荒空间中的遭遇，秦玄就是一阵恶寒，心中本来的绮念顿时熄灭。
那可是整整三百年，要不是有太荒空间还能让他休息，怕是真的要死在里面了。
将念头压下，随后便大略说了一些天墓中的情况，只是将和白衣女子相遇的过程给略去。
这个白衣女子太神秘，最好还是不要将秘密给泄露出去。
不过仅仅是一小部分的情报就让秦家长老听的大开眼界。
content_en:
Many elders of the Qin family spoke one after another.
Obviously, everyone has long been dissatisfied with the various blood-sucking Qin families of the Liu family.
If it weren't for the sake of the young patriarch, they would have fallen out with the Liu family long ago.
Now that the Liu family doesn't know whether to live or die, of course they are happy to see what happens.
Qin Yuan certainly had no objection to this result.
But...
Qin Xuan's cultivation is indeed completely gone.
Thinking of this, Qin Yuan felt sad in his heart.
Qin Xuan, the most promising person among the younger generation of the Qin family in Fire Wind City, has now become a useless person. How can he, who has always been proud and arrogant, accept this fact.
"Xuan'er, don't worry, no matter what happens in the future, as long as grandpa is here, I will definitely protect you and prevent you from suffering any grievances."
"As for your cultivation, don't worry about it yet. I still have some contacts. I will definitely be able to find a way to restore your cultivation by then!"
Although Qin Yuan was in severe pain about what happened to Qin Xuan, he still tried his best to comfort his grandson.
"Well, don't worry, Grandpa, I'm fine."
Qin Xuan smiled.
The three years in the Tomb of Heaven have tempered his character a lot.
Now he is able to remain calm.
"Okay, if you think so, I feel relieved a lot."
Qin Yuan nodded and said.
"Don't worry, the young patriarch is extremely talented and will definitely be able to restore his cultivation!"
Other elders also spoke one after another.
After a while, everyone turned their attention to Qin Xuan.
Seeing so many elders speaking to him, Qin Xuan felt warm in his heart.
Even if he becomes a useless person, these elders still support him.
"By the way, Xuan'er, what is it like inside the tomb? It is said that the tomb is so deep that the bottom cannot be seen. Is it true?"
Hearing this, Qin Xuan smiled bitterly.
"I fainted after entering the Sky Tomb. When I woke up, I was at the bottom of the Sky Tomb. But the strange thing is that in the Sky Tomb, the monk's cultivation will be completely suppressed, and no spiritual energy can be mobilized."
"You can only move with your body."
Speaking of this, Qin Xuan couldn't help but sigh.
When I woke up in the sky tomb, I encountered a lot of troubles. If it weren't for the woman in white, I might have died directly inside.
However, when he thought of what he had experienced in those three years in the wild space, Qin Xuan felt a chill, and the original longing in his heart was suddenly extinguished.
That was a full three hundred years. If it weren't for the vast space that allowed him to rest, he might have really died in it.
Suppressing his thoughts, he briefly talked about the situation in the sky tomb, but omitted the encounter with the woman in white.
This woman in white is too mysterious, it's best not to reveal her secret.
But just a small part of the information was an eye-opener for the Qin family.
